# Full-Scope Requirements Quality Checklist: Queue UX Refinements, Modal Image Picker, and Real-Duration Prediction

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality validation suite evaluating the completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and edge-case coverage across all 8 feature improvements.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [contracts/queue-api.md](../contracts/queue-api.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all retained visual elements in the streamlined "Video Nguồn" column (order index `#`, ETA prediction badge, preview toggle) explicitly documented with visual layout order? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the compact summary bar contents (`📁 Ảnh: X tệp • 🎬 Video: Y tệp`) and the "Đổi thư mục" re-expansion mechanism fully specified for all scan states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the modal image picker controls (full-resolution preview stage, horizontal thumbnail carousel, "Chọn ngẫu nhiên" button, "Xác nhận đổi" action) completely documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the historical telemetry regression weight update criteria documented with required minimum sample size thresholds? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 Are synchronization rules for merging in-flight queue items with newly detected video files explicitly defined for the non-destructive reload flow? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Are all REST API contract schemas (`/api/refresh-queue`, probed `/api/load-folders`) documented with explicit response status codes and JSON payloads? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Contract §queue-api]

## 2. Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [ ] CHK007 Is the sticky table header offset height explicitly quantified (e.g. 42px) in the active row auto-scroll calculation requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the mathematical formula for duration prediction (`estimate = fixed_overhead + (actual_duration * ratio)`) quantified with concrete baseline parameters (8s overhead, ~1.5 ratio)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the timing sequence and trigger condition between server API response `success: true` and client DOM step-marking explicitly documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK010 Is accessibility and operator discovery guidance (e.g. tooltip or title attribute) defined for inspecting the hidden video filename in Column 1? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the layout proportions and vertical partitioning between the full preview stage and the horizontal thumbnail carousel explicitly quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## 3. Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are row-locking requirements consistent between the client queue table rendering and server-side state persistence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the non-destructive refresh requirement align with Principle III (Fail-Safe Media) and Principle V (Observability) by preserving active renders and progress polling? [Consistency, Constitution §III, §V]
- [ ] CHK014 Are folder path input values consistently preserved when collapsing into the summary bar and re-expanding via "Đổi thư mục"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK015 Are duration prediction models consistent across both single-video preview badges and batch-level total ETA calculations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Plan §Technical Context]

## 4. Acceptance Criteria Quality & Measurability

- [ ] CHK016 Can the active row scroll alignment threshold (flush within 4px of the sticky table header bottom with 0px overlap) be objectively verified across various viewport heights? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the screen space reduction metric (>65% vertical reduction in collapsed setup state) measurable against a defined baseline height? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 Can the row-locking requirement (100% of finished rows have controls disabled) be objectively evaluated through DOM state inspection? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 Can the prediction error reduction (>50% improvement on non-30s videos) be objectively tested against recorded benchmark durations? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK020 Can timeline finalization fidelity (100% of finished videos displaying all 6 green checkmarks) be objectively validated in automated test scenarios? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK021 Is zero pipeline interruption during "Làm Mới" quantified with verifiable criteria (continuous FFmpeg process, uninterrupted SSE/poll cycle)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## 5. Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Does the spec define graceful fallback behavior when a video file has corrupted headers, zero byte length, or unreadable duration during scan? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Does the spec define user feedback and UI state when the candidate image folder contains only 1 image and "Chọn ngẫu nhiên" is triggered? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-006, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are client-side debouncing and duplicate request suppression specified for rapid repeated clicks on the "Làm Mới" control? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Does the spec define safeguarding or warning behavior if a user attempts to change or re-scan folder paths while a render batch is actively running? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Does the spec specify system behavior if a candidate image file is deleted from disk between scan time and modal confirmation? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 Are keyboard navigation and modal dismissal interactions (Escape key to cancel, Enter to confirm) addressed in requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]

## 6. Non-Functional & Resilience Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 Are duration probing performance constraints specified to prevent scan latency bottlenecks when processing folders with 50+ video files? [Non-Functional, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Are thumbnail rendering and DOM performance requirements defined for the modal carousel when browsing extensive image libraries? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK030 Are asynchronous error recovery flows defined for Step 6 if rendering succeeds but output file verification fails? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-011]
